# Keep the window-listener boolean result when lowering diagnostic severity

ExtensionSupport now warns for missing IDs, duplicate registration, missing callbacks and invalid removal. The same branches still return false. A warning does not mean registration or removal succeeded. Preserve the boolean contract and the refusal to mutate the hook map on these invalid inputs when changing diagnostics. This source does not establish a global rule that extension errors always belong at warning level.

Scope: mail/modules/ExtensionSupport.sys.mjs.
